course_name_original: Introdução aos Algoritmos e Estruturas de Dados (IAED3610)
course_name_en: Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures (IAED3610)
syllabus_topics: Introduction to imperative programming and the C programming language
Introduction to the study of algorithm efficiency
Elementary and advanced sorting algorithms: direct insertion, direct selection, bubblesort, quicksort, binary merge, heapsort, shellsort, counting sort and radix sort
Data types: stacks, queues, priority queues, heaps, trees
Collision resolution by chaining and open addressing
assessment_rules: The continuous assessment component (Project and Practical Test) is mandatory with a minimum grade of 7. The project (P) has two deliveries, P1 (40%) and P2 (60%), with P = 0.4*P1 + 0.6*P2. P1 can be improved in the second delivery up to a maximum of (20-P1)/2. The final project component grade (NP) is NP = min(P,TP)+sqrt(|P-TP|/2). The Exam (E) is mandatory with a minimum grade of 7. The final grade (NF) for both normal and resit periods is NF = 0.5*NP + 0.5*E.
bibliography: Robert Sedgewick, Algorithms in C, Addison-Wesley Publishing Company, 1997 (main)
Brian W. Kernighan, Dennis Ritchie, The C Programming Language,, Prentice Hall, 1988 (main)
T. Cormen, C. Leiserson, R. Rivest e C. Stein, Introduction to Algorithms, McGraw Hill e MIT Press, 2001 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática (LERC)
